title: Rigid media panel filters
description: Panel filters with a large filtration surface and low airflow resistance — primary filters and pre-filters for HEPA or carbon filters.
paragraphs: Panel filters made of rigid nonwoven media, Z-folded or finely pleated and bonded with separator lines, provide a large filtration surface and low airflow resistance — meaning lower electricity consumption and reduced overall operating costs. Filter media can vary — impregnated with activated carbon, antibacterial, or HT media for use at high temperatures up to 260°C.

These panel filters are ideal as primary air filters and as pre-filters for absolute HEPA or carbon filters, protecting them from premature dust loading. As primary filters they help reduce ventilation system maintenance costs by preventing unnecessary dust build-up on filter components, fans and ductwork.
